narrative_prose: The Hub Hearth glowed with the ambient hum of the ferrofluid sea, casting erratic orange and deep violet shadows across the metallic walls. A sharp, biting chill filled the room, offset only by bursts of radiant heat from the hearth itself. Ryn stood over the simmering braised mire-lentils, her brow furrowed as the air vibrated subtly with the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear. The rhythmic shockwaves rattled her heavy brass ladle on the butcher block and pushed the ozone intermingled with the comforting scent of warm iron-wheat bread into her nose. She snatched a fresh loaf from the basket before it slid off the vibrating counter. Marching over to where Silas stood staring at the rattling viewport, she shoved the warm, crusty loaf directly into his calloused hands. 'Check the dampener before we all starve, Engineer,' she barked.
